input_Phone.title: input_Phone
input_Phone.description: Person mobile as the patient typed it. Leave blank on WhatsApp when input_MessagingSessionId is set—the flow uses the channel sender address instead.

input_MessagingSessionId.title: input_MessagingSessionId
input_MessagingSessionId.description: Active MessagingSession Id from context. Required for WhatsApp auto-identity when input_Phone is blank.
